messages:
Iris: Hey team, random idea 1: rooftop tapas + board games Friday evening? Small group, chill vibe. Tapas place has a rooftop patio. Thoughts? :sun_with_face: :chopsticks:
Noah: Love it. What time are you thinking? 6:30pm?
Iris: 6:30 works for me. Might need a reservation for 8-10 people.
Sam: I'm in! Can do 6:30. I can bring one travel game (Love Letter).
Gina: Maybe 7pm for me  later commute. If most people prefer 6:30 I'll try to make it. Vegan tapas options?
Victor: 6:30 is fine. I can handle a quick RSVP. Also I can bring a portable charger/extra seats.
EventBot: Poll created: "Start at 6:30 vs 7:00" Poll open 24h.
Noah: 6:30 vote from me.
Gina: Voting 7:00 (commute).
Iris: Poll results: 6:30 6 votes, 7:00 2 votes. Rooftop booked for 8 people at 6:30pm. Venue: TerraTapas Rooftop (link: https://terratapas.example). RSVP: please add dietary notes.
Sam: Added Sam. Bringing Love Letter and a spare deck.
Gina: I'll push my commute earlier  can make 6:30 now. Adding Gina. Vegan tapas appreciated.
Iris: Great! I'll bring napkins & a small card for game rules. Closing thread  will DM final details and the rooftop host contact.
